jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software. We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades : Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload. This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work. You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage. The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows. Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products. Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows. Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases. Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration. Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions. Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop. Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention. Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart. Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows. Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments. Must-Have Skills 7+ years of product management experience , including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end. Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering. Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas , from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration. Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products , including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring. Strong customer discovery and product judgment , with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities. Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment , with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity. Proven cross-functional ownership , working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams. English at C1 level and German at C2 level. Willingness to stay close to customers and the team , including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent). Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI , particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows. Experience with AI monetisation , including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models. Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades . Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits . Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish . WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit. You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new. You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions. You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to. And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Flexibility : Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option. Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment : We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page . Diversity makes us better. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for. ______ On the application process We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here . If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you. Note on creating a test account: If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own AI and automation initiatives that improve how our teams work, starting with Connect API and the workflows behind our connectivity platform. You will find the problems worth solving, define requirements and work with AI and platform engineers to ship tools teams use - measured by better outcomes, less manual effort and reliable daily use. Over time you will also help bring AI capabilities into our customer-facing products. We are hiring in Berlin, Germany, and Lisbon, Portugal. About the Role Lead discovery with internal users and workflow owners to find where AI or automation makes a measurable difference. Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for your initiatives - prioritize value, impact, effort and risk, and decide what to pursue, defer or stop. Turn user needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria and success measures, including exceptions and human review. Work with AI and platform engineers from discovery to rollout, agreeing on evaluation and release criteria and, with security and compliance, requirements for access, sensitive data and human approval. Deliver value from day one - stay hands-on, find the highest-friction workflows and ship working improvements early, keeping a continuous cadence of incremental delivery rather than long roadmap cycles. Requirements About You 5+ years in product management, with end-to-end ownership of technical products, APIs, platforms or internal tools. Hands-on experience delivering AI-native capabilities or AI-enabled workflows used in practice, and able to explain the decisions, adoption and results. You prototype your own ideas rather than only specifying them - comfortable using AI coding and automation tools to get something testable in front of users quickly. Practical understanding of LLM capabilities and limits, including retrieval from internal knowledge and tools or API calling. Confident using product data and user feedback to set baselines and assess impact; sound judgement on sensitive data and human oversight. Strong discovery and problem-solving skills, a track record of driving adoption, and clear written and verbal English. Good to Have Internal AI platforms, knowledge tools, workflow automation or developer-facing products; familiarity with MCP. A software engineering or computer science background, or equivalent hands-on technical experience. SQL, API testing or hands-on prototyping; working proficiency in Portuguese or German a plus. Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the team Checkout.com is building the infrastructure that will allow merchants to be discovered, transacted with and paid through AI agents. Agentic commerce is moving quickly from concept to production. AI platforms, card schemes and merchants are developing different protocols for discovery, cart, payment, identity and consent. No standard has won, and merchants should not have to rebuild their commerce stack for every new platform. We are looking for a Product Manager to help make Checkout.com the layer that connects this ecosystem. This is a 0→1 role in a new product area with live merchant and platform activity, a growing inventory API, ACP and UCP work, and a roadmap that will extend across discovery, cart and payment. What you will own Define and execute the product strategy for Agentic Commerce, balancing what merchants need now with the infrastructure that will matter as the market develops. Turn a fragmented protocol landscape-including ACP, UCP, Visa and Mastercard agent programmes, and emerging trust and intent standards-into a coherent, protocol-agnostic product experience. Build the next stage of the product: live catalogue and inventory feeds that make merchants discoverable across AI surfaces, followed by the right cart and orchestration capabilities. Extend Checkout.com ’s payment strengths into agentic flows: delegated credentials, authentication, agent identification, consent, risk decisioning, approval performance and dispute evidence. Work directly with AI platforms, schemes, merchants and internal commercial teams to understand real integration requirements and turn pilots into repeatable products. Own the product details end to end: APIs, developer experience, merchant onboarding, operational controls, reporting, commercial model and launch readiness. Lead cross-functional delivery with Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Partnerships, Marketing and Sales. Make decisions, resolve dependencies and keep work moving. Explain complex technical and regulatory questions clearly to engineers, merchants, partners and senior leadership. What success looks like Merchants can integrate once and reach multiple AI surfaces as their protocols mature. The first agentic merchants go live quickly, with a clear path from pilot to repeatable onboarding. The inventory and payment experiences are reliable, observable and simple for developers to use. Agentic transactions have the controls and signals needed to protect merchants, improve approval rates and handle disputes. Checkout.com has a differentiated position based on merchant value and payment performance-not just a list of protocol integrations. The roadmap is grounded in evidence: merchant demand, usage, approval value, integration effort and commercial potential. Skills and experience Strong product management experience building merchant-facing infrastructure, platform or API products. Experience in payments is highly valued. Working knowledge of card payments: authorisation, tokenisation, PSP/acquirer flows, wallets, 3DS/SCA, risk and schemes. Curiosity about AI agents and how they use tools, permissions, mandates and payment credentials. You do not need to be an AI researcher, but you do need to understand the implications for commerce and payments. Evidence of owning an ambiguous 0→1 problem and taking it from customer discovery through launch and iteration. The judgement to separate table stakes from genuine differentiation, and to change direction when the market or evidence changes. Comfort working with external partners and senior stakeholders. You will need to represent Checkout.com , not simply attend the meeting. This role is a good fit if You are comfortable being early, technical and commercially accountable at the same time. You can move between a merchant conversation, an API contract, a scheme requirement and an investment case and make each one clearer. It is not a role for someone looking for a settled market, a fully formed roadmap or a narrow feature area. The opportunity is to help define the category while building something merchants can use now. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d) - Internship - Digital Supply Chain
jobs.description: Notre équipe Digital Supply Chain recherche un·e Product Manager (f/m/d) en Stage, basé·e à Paris. Au sein du domaine "Downstream Replenishment", notre collectif a pour mission de concevoir et de transformer les produits numériques qui optimisent la disponibilité de nos produits sportifs dans le monde entier. Composée de Product Managers, Data Scientists et Data Analysts, notre équipe fait le pont entre la tech et le business pour relever un défi de taille : acheminer le bon produit, au bon endroit, au bon moment, grâce à l'IA et aux modèles de données avancés. TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION En tant que Stagiaire Product Manager, tu rejoins une équipe agile. Ta mission principale sera de prendre en charge le déploiement international de l'un de nos produits numériques clés auprès de nos entrepôts et magasins. Tes responsabilités principales : Soutien au Déploiement et à la Scalabilité du Produit : Participer activement au déploiement opérationnel de notre solution de supply chain à l'échelle internationale et aider à son industrialisation. Accompagnement au Changement : Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe pour accompagner les utilisateur·ices finaux·les (Supply Planners), faciliter l'adoption du produit et co-animer des sessions de formation. Appui au User Discovery : Contribuer à recueillir les retours qualitatifs et quantitatifs du terrain pour aider l'équipe produit à enrichir la roadmap et à optimiser les fonctionnalités futures. Suivi de la Performance : Aider à la mise en place et à l'analyse des indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs) liés à l'adoption du produit et à l'efficacité opérationnelle. Vie de l'Équipe Agile : Participer activement aux rituels de l'équipe (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, rétrospectives) pour s'imprégner de la culture agile. CE QUE TU APPORTES Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité curieuse, orientée solutions et dotée d'un excellent relationnel. Formation : En cours de Master (Bac+5) en école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou équivalent universitaire. Compétences relationnelles & Soft Skills : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques pour des profils business, esprit d'analyse et autonomie. Appétences : Un fort intérêt pour les défis de la Supply Chain et la tech. Langues : Anglais courant indispensable (contexte international quotidien). Le français est un plus. Note importante : Si tu n'as pas d'expérience dans le sport mais que tu es passionné·e par les défis de la tech et de la supply chain, ta candidature a toute sa place chez nous !   STACK TECHNIQUE Outils de gestion de produit & Agile (Jira, Confluence) Outils d'analyse de données (Looker, SQL ou équivalents sont un plus) CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ; Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ; Développement des compétences et accompagnement (coaching sur mesure, formations internes et externes, etc.) ; Immersion dans notre culture sportive (accès aux clubs de sport internes, tests de produits). NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de tous niveaux de compétences à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es. Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement. DECATHLON DIGITAL  Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits. Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
